posts.title: Korean Health Supplement Suppliers 2026: K-Supplement Sourcing Guide

images.alt: Sliced Korean red ginseng root pieces filling the frame.
images.caption: Red ginseng remains Korea's flagship health functional food category and the usual entry point for overseas supplement buyers. Photo via Wikimedia Commons (CC0).

images.alt: Korean red ginseng powder packaging showing manufacturer details, a GMP designation mark, and 6-year-root labeling.
images.caption: Korean supplement packaging typically carries the manufacturer's registered name and address, certification marks, and grade claims — all details a buyer should verify against source documents rather than accept from a catalog. Photo by karendotcom127 via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0).

images.alt: Interior of a Korean pharmacy with shelves of supplements including lutein, milk thistle, and omega-3 products.
images.caption: Korean pharmacies stock the same functional categories buyers source for export — lutein, milk thistle, omega-3, and calcium — which makes the domestic shelf a useful reality check on what actually sells. Photo via Wikimedia Commons (CC0).
